name: devtrack
description: Read local DevTrack work context and deterministic Sage knowledge over MCP.
long_description: DevTrack is a local developer-context layer. This bundle exposes ten read-only tools backed by an existing DevTrack SQLite database and local deterministic Sage Markdown; it does not start the optional Python AI server or send data to a hosted MCP endpoint.

database_path.title: DevTrack SQLite database
database_path.description: Select the devtrack.db created by DevTrack setup.

tools.name: get_active_context
tools.description: Get the active ticket, repository, commit count, and mapping confidence.

tools.name: get_today_commits
tools.description: Get today's commits grouped by ticket.

tools.name: get_pending_actions
tools.description: Inspect actions waiting in DevTrack's review queue.

tools.name: get_ticket_context
tools.description: Get commits and pending actions for a ticket.

tools.name: sage_search
tools.description: Search complete entries in current deterministic Sage knowledge.

tools.name: sage_topics
tools.description: List current Sage topics and entry counts.

tools.name: sage_get_entry
tools.description: Get one exact current Sage entry by topic and line.

tools.name: sage_status
tools.description: Get bounded local Sage capture, pipeline, and adapter status.
